learnables.gloss: though / on the other hand — the contrastive particle, second in its clause
learnables.predictableError: English speakers put it first, on the model of 'but' ('Pa ti dobro angleško'), or reach for 'ampak'. 'pa' is a SECOND-POSITION particle that attaches to the thing being contrasted — 'Ti pa dobro angleško', 'Jaz pa ne'. 'ampak' opens a whole contrasting clause; 'pa' contrasts one element inside one.
